statements.subject: connection
statements.description: PPTP requires the establishment of a tunnel for each communicating PNS-PAC pair. This tunnel is used to carry all user session PPP packets for sessions involving a given PNS-PAC pair.
statements.trigger: tunnel establishment required for PNS-PAC pair
actions: establish GRE tunnel between PNS-PAC pair

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The value to use in the key field is established by the call establishment procedure which takes place on the control connection.
statements.trigger: call establishment procedure completes on control connection
actions: assign GRE key field value for session

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The control connection is used to determine rate and buffering parameters that are used to regulate the flow of PPP packets for a particular session over the tunnel.
statements.trigger: session flow parameters negotiated on control connection
